sources.title: Fractus CTE — A Continuous Cognitive Agent - Fractus CTE Wiki
sources.snippet: Fractus is a Continuous Cognitive Agent — an AI that works like a brain, not a calculator. Instead of processing input → output in one pass, Fractus ticks like a biological system: it maintains a persistent thought state, advances it through multiple blocks of processing, remembers everything across sessions, and can grow new capacity by itself.
